This neuron has no clean semantic category; it fires (weakly, only ~mid-range) on the highly predictable continuation token inside a fixed multi-token word or formulaic phrase in boilerplate web text — a word-completing sub-word ("Spand|au"), the closing quote after reported speech, an article/particle demanded by a set phrase ("open **an** account", "non-grazed"), or the "%," in a list of percentages — and is strongly *suppressed* by other such predictable completions (" own" in "their own", " inn", "T" in "TBC", "1" in "1950").

L31·N4987unmasked layer
Fires on the final content word that completes a clause/sentence — the token immediately preceding a period (e.g. "increased.", "Truths", "love with it.", "scattered about.", "updated daily") — i.e., a "phrase is now complete" signal; it is strongly suppressed on function words that force continuation ("than", "for", "of", head nouns before an appositive).
